prompt: Use case: compositing, identity preservation. Create one production reference sheet with THREE EQUAL HORIZONTAL LANDSCAPE FRAMES STACKED VERTICALLY, edge-to-edge with NO BORDER or text, overall aspect 16:27. Each row independently 16:9. First image is exact level scenery reference: familiar suburban backyard at twilight, warm paper lanterns, white picket fence, apple trees and house with lit windows, grass path, whimsical distant giant mushrooms. Second image is exact approved owner and dog reference. Third image is exact approved running dog. Maintain polished warm hand-painted animated-film style and EXACT same adult golden retriever identity, complete black nose, friendly muzzle, golden fur, BLACK leather collar and ROUND gold tag saying BIT, all paws. Never draw another version of the dog. TOP ROW: seated dog center-right eagerly watching owner's Bitcoin; owner far left seen from back with sage shirt, slate pants and cream shoes, crop his whole head and neck above the row's top edge; show torso hands shoes only, absolutely NO face or head. Gold Bitcoin in owner's right hand at hip, ready before throwing. Keep entire seated dog and tail/paws inside frame. MIDDLE ROW: entirely empty forward POV along this level's path toward horizon with open sky, matching first reference's scenery; NO dog, owner, coins, star, trails or words. BOTTOM ROW: exact approved golden retriever joyfully galloping RIGHT in side profile centered on this level's path, full body nose ears tail paws all visible with generous margins, no owner; camera side-on, not toward viewer. Plain readable dog silhouette against contrasting scenery, no speed streaks or motion blur crossing face. All three rows match first image environment and lighting. Clear anatomy, four legs only. No costume or spacesuit. No grid lines, labels or captions. This is artwork to be cropped into three independent shots.
processing: Three inspected cinematic frames cropped at row boundaries; throw and sprint animated with Kling V3 Pro. Owner head/neck always cropped off; approved dog black collar, BIT gold tag.
